reason: The primary user-facing purpose is to expose external package and security intelligence to DeepSeek Harness as callable tools, evidenced by the plugin’s own description and README detailing MCP-over-HTTP integration, multiple read-only pkgseek_* tool operations, and API-base configuration.

summaries.zh: dsh-plugin-pkgseek 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过接入 PkgSeek 服务为用户提供 Linux 软件包、命令建议、CVE 漏洞与发布周期等只读情报工具。
summaries.en: dsh-plugin-pkgseek is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that integrates with PkgSeek to provide read-only Linux package, command, and security-intelligence tools directly in the DSH workflow.

capabilities: Forwards user tool requests to PkgSeek’s MCP-over-HTTP endpoint and registers returned tool definitions as native DSH tools.
Provides read-only Linux package, command, vulnerability (CVE), and distro lifecycle tooling via names like pkgseek_search_packages and pkgseek_search_vulnerabilities.
Supports runtime configuration for API endpoint, request timeout, prompt guidance, tool refresh behavior, and optional tool allowlisting.
Uses snapshot fallback when live discovery fails, then surfaces call failures clearly instead of crashing the host profile.

reasons.code: README states the plugin is a thin adapter over PkgSeek’s public MCP-over-HTTP endpoint and forwards calls as tools/call with read-only operations.
README lists numerous remote-intelligence tools for package search, install resolution, command diagnosis, CVE lookup, and distro lifecycle planning.
Repository description explicitly defines the plugin as Linux package, command and CVE intelligence for DeepSeek Harness.
